assertions.name: kappa_tower_tightens_scale_stays_anchor_blind
assertions.source: summing kappa1..kappa4 shifts Im V_b 0.0578->0.0548 (odd rungs only) and stays anchor-blind at both anchors

description: Joint tightening (coordination with #3628): extend the merged #3654 finite-b state-integral S-scale using #3628's exact Ohtsuki tower κ₁..κ₄ (κ₁=11√3π/108, κ₂=2π²/27, κ₃=1081√3π³/21870, κ₄=98π⁴/729). At the substrate 2πb²=i·t, so Im 𝔙_b (bar-odd S) is fed ONLY by odd rungs (t·κ₁−t³·κ₃) and Re 𝔙_b by even rungs — the state-integral realization of #3628's √3-parity alternation (odd→√3→Im, even→rational→Re). The κ-tower tightens the S scale 0.0578→0.0548 (−5.21%), still smooth + anchor-blind. Exact anchor-dependent S is the 1/u³ ladder representation of this smooth object (merged #3636), not Im 𝔙_b; the tower refines the scale, not the sign-flip. κ values cited from #3628. Scope-(a); C14; no c_k wired; no fit.

kappa_tower.parity: odd rungs sqrt3 -> Im (bar-odd S); even rungs rational -> Re (Vol)

conclusion.note: tightens smooth scale; exact S = 1/u^3 ladder representation (#3636), not Im V_b
